newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak tourism agency sees '96 revenues up 34 pct.
newsitem.headline: Slovak tourism agency sees '96 revenues up 34 pct.

text.p: The Slovak Tourist Agency on Tuesday said it expects tourism revenues for 1996 to rise by some 34 percent to $750 million, up from some $560 million in 1995.
According to figures published by the Slovak Bureau of Statistics (SUSR) for the first 11 months of last year, 30.7 million tourists visited Slovakia, compared to 27.3 million for the whole of 1995.
The number of Slovaks travelling abroad also rose, hitting 21.1 million persons in the first 11 months of last year, compared to 18 million for the whole of 1995, SUSR said.
